cards.text: Isaiah the prophet has been carrying the Lord's word, and the Lord just said these people honor Him with their lips while their hearts are far from Him (Isaiah 29:13). Now Isaiah says woe to those who dig deep to hide their plans from the LORD. That's me burying a burnt batch under THREE paper towels at the bottom of the bakery trash, and friend, the WHOLE planet still smells like smoke.

cards.question: These folks are digging deep to hide their plans from the LORD. Where do they do their works?
The people hiding their plans from the LORD think nobody sees what they're doing.

cards.text: Then Isaiah says, "You have turned things upside down, as if the potter were regarded as clay." Picture a pot talking back to the one who formed it.

cards.question: Isaiah pictures a pot talking back to the potter who formed it. What does he picture the pot saying?

answers.text: He made me in a hurry

cards.text: Then Isaiah asks: can the pottery say of the potter, "He has no understanding"? Clay. With OPINIONS.
Then Isaiah asks: won't Lebanon, a land famous for its cedars, become an orchard, and the orchard seem like a forest? That's not a little touch-up, friend. That's a full MAKEOVER.

cards.question: Isaiah says Lebanon becoming an orchard will take a very long time.

cards.text: On that day, Isaiah says, the deaf and the blind are in for a change. Friend, I spent years in the dark at the back of a junk drawer, so ANY line with "out of the deep darkness" in it gets my full attention.

cards.question: On that day, the deaf will ___ the words of the scroll, and out of the deep darkness the eyes of the blind will ___.

cards.text: Then Isaiah turns to the humble and the poor among men. Friend, lean in, because this part is good.

cards.question: What does Isaiah say the humble and the poor will do?

cards.text: Then Isaiah says why: the ruthless will vanish, and the mockers will disappear.

cards.question: Isaiah says one more group will be cut down: all who look for ___.

cards.text: Isaiah spells out who they are: people who indict a man with a word and ensnare the mediator at the gate. One word and you're in trouble, like the coworker who says "Hmm" in the meeting and suddenly the boss wants to see YOU.

cards.question: These evildoers also take justice away from the innocent. How do they do it?

cards.text: Hold on, friend, because now the LORD Himself speaks, the LORD who redeemed Abraham, the man He made the father of many nations (Genesis 17:5). He's talking about the house of Jacob, Abraham's grandson (Genesis 21:3; 25:26).

cards.question: The LORD who redeemed Abraham says Jacob will go on being ashamed.

cards.text: Then the LORD tells what happens when Jacob sees his children around him. Friend, I KNOW that picture: six little cookie cutters crowding me on the counter, all talking at ONCE.

cards.question: When Jacob sees his children around him, what does the LORD call them?
When Jacob sees his children around him, the LORD says they will ___ His name.

cards.text: Last, the LORD says the wayward in spirit will come to understanding. Then He gets to the grumblers, and friend, back in the family kitchen where I used to stamp cookies, I gave every shiny new mixer that came through the door the side-eye and a LOT of mumbling.

cards.question: The LORD says those who grumble will accept instruction.
